Look folks, it is completely crystal clear what is happening to our hardworking business owners and the productive class in this country. Just look at the owner of Blue Waters, who rightly had the courage to call out an overreaching government that just collects taxes "without doing or investing in anything." This is the bitter reality of a bloated bureaucracy that wants to take from the people who actually build and produce while offering nothing in return.

And how do the leftists and environmental bureaucrats respond? Naturally, they are scheming to exploit this exact situation by slapping yet another burden on business, claiming that "Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax." They never stop inventing new ways to control our lives under the false banner of saving the planet, launching a total shakedown of the productive class to fund their endless schemes.

Instead of backing local enterprise and personal responsibility, what is their real obsession? They whine that "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..." Instead of restoring basic civic pride, personal accountability, and the traditional values that kept our communities strong and orderly, these progressive institutions just want to tax us to cover up the cultural decay they created. It is time to stand up for traditional values, social order, and the people who actually keep this nation running.
